spans.view: with shelves of boxed snacks and candy behind her

beats.text: Polly holds a shopping basket in one fin and looks closely at a small red candy packet in the other
Polly reaches out and puts the candy packet back on the shelf
Polly sways gently with her eyes closed and a small smile, one fin raised in the air
Polly lowers her fin, opens her eyes and looks ahead with a slightly glum face
